requirements.text: UST is looking for a strong Java Backend Engineer to work on a multi-vendor multi-geo team to help build a NextGen High Scale Enterprise Platform. This is strictly work from office position and is not open to remote roles.
Skills and experiences: 5-6 years hands on experience in Java development at enterprise level (recent).
Experience in working Java Version 18 or above is mandatory 3-4 years of hands-on experience with Kafka 2-3 years of solid experience in Kubernetes
Implemented and managed event-driven systems using Apache Kafka, including producers, consumers, topic management, message serialization, and performance tuning.
Deployed, monitored, and managed containerized applications on Kubernetes, including pod configuration, service discovery, scaling, and troubleshooting.
Mandatory: Java, Spring Boot, Kafka, Kubernetes Rest API, SQL, Cosmos DB (or any NO SQL)
Designed, developed, and maintained enterprise-grade Java applications using Java 18+, adhering to object-oriented programming principles and design patterns.
Understanding of microservices architecture and experience in building and deploying microservices-based applications

Hands-on experience in developing Spring Boot applications, including dependency injection, ORM (Object-Relational Mapping), and REST API development Knowledge of Microsoft Azure cloud platform, including Azure App Service, Azure Functions, Azure SQL or COSTMOS DB Familiarity with Continuous Integration (CI) and Continuous Deployment (CD) practices, including automated testing, build pipelines, and deployment strategies
Proficiency in writing SQL queries as per industrial standards, fine-tuned for optimization

Hands-on experience in developing Spring Boot applications, including dependency injection, ORM (Object-Relational Mapping), and REST API development Knowledge of Microsoft Azure cloud platform, including Azure App Service, Azure Functions, Azure SQL or COSTMOS DB Familiarity with Continuous Integration (CI) and Continuous Deployment (CD) practices, including automated testing, build pipelines, and deployment strategies

Hands-on experience in developing Spring Boot applications, including dependency injection, ORM (Object-Relational Mapping), and REST API development Knowledge of Microsoft Azure cloud platform, including Azure App Service, Azure Functions, Azure SQL or COSTMOS DB Familiarity with Continuous Integration (CI) and Continuous Deployment (CD) practices, including automated testing, build pipelines, and deployment strategies
Strong problem-solving abilities, good communication (written & verbal) skills, and the ability to work effectively in a team are also important for this role.
Bachelor’s degree in computer science, or a related field is required as it is a complex specialized program
Candidate should be available for in person (face to face) evaluation and is expected to go in detail about the recent project roles and responsibilities.
